description: This file defines functions related to the visual theming of a dashboard or UI, specifically providing a base theme (getOceanTheme) and color palette utilities (getCategoricalPalette, getCategoryColorMap). It exports theme tokens like colors, typography, radius, and elevation, and contains functions for generating and mapping categorical color palettes.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns the Ocean Professional base theme tokens including colors, typography, radius, and elevation settings.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Returns a deterministic color palette for categorical series, seeded by predefined Ocean theme colors, with ability to generate additional colors dynamically.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Creates a mapping of category names to specific colors from the categorical palette, maintaining stable color assignments for categories.
